job.name: ig16_host_a
job.meaning: мужчина ~38, тёмные короткие волосы, щетина, татуировки на предплечьях, чёрная футболка, тёмно-зелёный бархатный диван, кирпичная стена, тёплые лампы
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a Russian man about 38 with short dark hair and dark stubble, slightly rough look, tattoo sleeves on both forearms, a plain black t-shirt, a silver ring, kind warm eyes. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium shot from mid-thigh up, he sits relaxed on a sofa slightly turned, both shoulders and hands inside the frame, a black podcast microphone on a boom arm near his face on the side (not covering the mouth), face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking slightly off-camera toward an unseen interviewer, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, one hand in a calm open gesture, sincere thoughtful expression, NO broad smile. Look: a real frame from a high-end podcast camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark. Background: a cosy podcast studio with an exposed red-brick wall, dark green velvet sofa, warm Edison bulbs and a small plant, soft moody light.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real. For a podcast he looks slightly off-camera at the interviewer — this is intended.

attempts.issue: Person is not looking directly at the camera and face is slightly turned away from frontal view.
The subject is not facing front or looking into the camera; face must be straight-on looking directly at the camera.
The subject is not looking directly into the camera, and the mouth is caught mid-speech.
